scope: exploratory fold1 development; prior validation exposure acknowledged

route_a.backbone: chronos2 2.2.2, existing pinned weights and raw Q0.5
route_a.acceptance: strict decrease in two-group training MSE averaged across H3/H12
route_a.query_budget: each proposal scores before and after on 4 origins x 2 horizons; each call contains the two affected groups
route_a.residuals: rolling out-of-sample own-history ridge with lags 1,2,24,48,168 and calendar harmonics; blocks 288:384,384:480,480:576
route_a.validation: all registered validation origins; no validation-guided partition changes
route_a.gate: candidate >=1% macro clipped RMSE improvement over best matched K32 control, no macro MAE degradation, <=1% RMSE degradation in either horizon
route_a.efficiency_claim: none without separate controlled timing; search cost and calls are reported

route_b.data: bounded first648 duration.csv and occupancy.csv plus static capacities
route_b.duration_normalization: declared pile-hours / capacity / one hour; numerical bounds checked, not proof of timestamp semantics
route_b.input_availability: duration shifted one row behind each occupancy history row
route_b.operator: bounded occupancy path O; active path A=O*sigmoid(a); occupancy endpoint and average active exposure. Free controls use independent sigmoid active path
route_b.alignment: left uses duration[target-1]; right uses duration[target]; report both, do not select a physical truth convention by validation
route_b.gate: information gain tested versus occupancy_only; mechanism gain tested versus same-input concat/free controls at matching alignment; >=1% macro RMSE and no macro MAE degradation
route_b.qualification_gate: unresolved units, release availability, alignment or coverage preclude physical-identification claims even if numerical scores improve
route_b.stop: invalid/nonfinite or out-of-bound normalized duration blocks bounded operator training; no silent clipping

publish: code, protocols, aggregates and hashes only; no raw targets, partitions, predictions or model parameters
